differences.b_observable: The camera is further back, showing more of the surrounding tiles, with a flatter perspective.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera focal length and position to match the tighter framing and perspective of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center, showing a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are nearly as bright as the center, with a very weak vignette.
differences.fix: Increase the vignette strength in the camera or post-processing.

differences.b_observable: The shadows are much lighter and softer, resulting in a flatter look.
differences.fix: Adjust the shadow density and contrast to match the deeper shadows of the reference.
